blocks.text: Cybersecurity
Cybersecurity is the practice of protecting computers, networks, data, and online accounts from unauthorized access, misuse, damage, or cyberattacks.
Online Safety
Online safety means using the Internet carefully and responsibly to protect personal information, devices, and digital identity.
Strong Password
A strong password is a secure password that is difficult to guess. It usually includes a combination of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols.
Privacy Settings
Privacy settings are options on digital platforms that allow users to control who can see their personal information, posts, profile, location, and online activity.
Privacy Policy
A privacy policy explains how an application, website, or organisation collects, uses, stores, and shares user data.
Digital Collaboration
Digital collaboration means working together online using tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams, shared documents, video meetings, and group chats.
Digital Etiquette
Digital etiquette refers to polite, respectful, and responsible behaviour while communicating online.
Cyber Threat
A cyber threat is any possible danger to digital systems, data, or users. Examples include phishing, malware, ransomware, hacking, and identity theft.
Phishing
Phishing is a cyberattack in which fake emails, messages, or websites trick users into sharing passwords, bank details, or personal information.
Malware
Malware is harmful software designed to damage a computer, steal data, or disturb normal system operations.
Ransomware
Ransomware is a type of malware that locks files or systems and demands payment to restore access.
Two-Factor Authentication
Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) is a security method that requires two forms of verification, such as a password and a code sent to a mobile phone.
Biometric Verification
Biometric verification uses unique physical features, such as fingerprints, face recognition, or voice recognition, to confirm a user’s identity.
Firewall
A firewall is a security tool that monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic according to security rules.
Antivirus Software
Antivirus software is a program used to detect, block, and remove viruses and other harmful software from a computer.
Cryptography
Cryptography is the technique of protecting information by converting it into a secure form so that only authorized users can read it.
Data Protection
Data protection means keeping personal, academic, organizational, or sensitive information safe from loss, misuse, theft, or unauthorized access.
Accessibility
Accessibility means designing digital systems so that people with different abilities, needs, and backgrounds can use them easily.
Intellectual Property
Intellectual property refers to creations of the mind, such as software, books, images, videos, designs, and inventions, that are legally owned by individuals or organisations.
Data Privacy Laws
Data privacy laws are legal rules that protect how personal data is collected, stored, used, and shared.
E-Waste
E-waste means discarded electronidevices, such as old computers, mobile phones, batteries, printers, and chargers.
Sustainable Computing
Sustainable computing means using, designing, and disposing of technology in a way that reduces harm to the environment.
Entrepreneurship
Entrepreneurship is the process of creating innovative business ideas, solving problems, and developing opportunities using technology and digital platforms.
Digital Entrepreneurship
Digital entrepreneurship involves using the Internet, social media, e-commerce, or digital tools to create and manage businesses or services.
